t: DEWALT 10" long nose pliers feature a robust, compound-action design to deliver enhanced cutting power, with induction-hardened cutting blades for long-lasting strength and durability. The cross-hatch tooth design enhances gripping, while the spring-loaded mechanism allows for easy operation. Ideal for cutting wire, chains, and bolts. Also features comfortable bi-material handles to provide a secure hold during prolonged use. Suitable for use during electrical installations, plumbing repairs, and general workshop tasks.
